name: 4x-ship-tools
description: Offline art pipeline for the ship fleet. Not part of the Unity build.
//: sharp is PINNED and overridden to a single version on purpose. @gltf-transform/functions pulls sharp in via ndarray-pixels; if npm installs a second copy at a different version, both native libvips modules load into the same process and every image op dies with 'colourspace: parameter space not set'. One sharp, or no image resizing.
